source_handling: Mercier's meal examples and servants comparison remain attributed observations; rhetorical fractions, giant prices, ethnic stereotypes and contempt for poor people are excluded. Cookbook is prescriptive and the two dinners are composites.
asset_checks: One poultry platter remains identifiable from table to service space; show reduced meat after service, never a magically whole new bird.
Raw cabbage becomes cooked pieces; prevent raw-green-leaf reset after braising.
Sauce stream lands in sieve and receiving bowl, hands/proportions checked full-size.
All period shop ovens use wood/fire and masonry; no modern cooker.
Small purchase is visibly small but substantial loaf and people retain dignity.
